acceptanceCriteria: A dispatched worker whose attempt stays LEASE_EXPIRED past the configured grace has its attempt reaped, its allocation released through quarantine and cleanup, and the worker signalled TERM then KILL, covered by a test with a non-renewing worker.
A lease-expired event is recorded, and the grace setting is closed, bounded and documented in the dispatch spec.
Workers within the grace, or that renew, are untouched (test).
body:
Filed 2026-10-08 by the orchestrator.

GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#674 (owner, 2026-10-08, main-0b5096c, 4-member demo-lanes pool, load 20-40 on 10 CPUs). A dispatched worker that is still running but no longer renews keeps its expired attempt: queue status shows holderStatus LEASE_EXPIRED with phase RUNNING, the pool allocation stays ALLOCATED, and the ticket is blocked as ATTEMPT_LIVE. Observed holds of 50-75 minutes past expiry. At 10:22Z three of four members were held by expired attempts, and no ticket completed for six hours. #622 covered the exited-worker case only. Today the only remedy is an external operator reap. Expected: after a configured grace (for example roles[].expiredLeaseGraceSeconds), the dispatcher reaps the attempt (allocation follows quarantine then cleanup), signals the worker TERM then KILL after idleSeconds as for the wall-time limit, and records a lease-expired event. Optional: deliver a stop-and-hand-off notice first when the adapter supports message injection.

completion.reason: GitHub #674 delivered by PR #678, merged to main as ecfff8e0 on 2026-10-08 (issue #674 closed). Dispatch now reaps an attempt that stays LEASE_EXPIRED past a closed, bounded grace setting documented in docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md: it records a lease-expired event, releases the allocation through quarantine and cleanup, and signals the identity-verified worker TERM then KILL. lease_expired_test.go covers a non-renewing worker being reaped and workers within the grace or renewing being untouched; dispatch_lease_expired_test.go and lease_reap_fence_test.go cover the CLI and the store fence, including refusing an empty reap expiry and never cancelling a lease-expired stop found on restart. Focused tests passed in the lane; hosted CI passed on the PR; independent Codex review findings were fixed before the seal. Change evidence sealed as .corvint/changes/8b5c65ef….cem.json (dogfood-check hunks=45 supported=45 unknown=0). Evidence digests are the sha256 of the cited files at ecfff8e0. NOT_RUN: make gate and ./... locally. Manual completion because the lane did not hold a native claim.

title: Tasks dispatch: reap a running worker's attempt and stop the worker once its lease has been expired past a grace period (issue 674)
